banting-best-1924.alt: Two young men in suits sit side by side in an office, in front of a bookcase. A black-and-white photo.
banting-best-1924.caption: Best (left) and Banting, about 1924. Their team first gave insulin to people with diabetes in 1922.

fda-lab-1960s.alt: A man in a white shirt reaches up to a lamp in a laboratory full of glass flasks, bottles and racks of test tubes.
fda-lab-1960s.caption: An FDA scientist checks for impurities in the 1960s. The FDA is the US medicines regulator.

kennedy-1962-drug-amendments.alt: President Kennedy sits at his desk and hands a pen to a senator. Men in suits and one woman stand around him.
kennedy-1962-drug-amendments.caption: President Kennedy after signing a new drug law in 1962. Now medicines had to show they work.

gila-monster.alt: A Gila monster, a heavy lizard with beaded black and orange-pink skin, walking over red rocks and dry grass at night.
gila-monster.caption: A Gila monster. Its venom led to a drug that works like semaglutide, which copies a human hormone.

lab-mouse.alt: A small brown laboratory mouse sitting on the palm of a hand in a blue disposable glove.
lab-mouse.caption: A laboratory mouse. KPV research so far is in cells and animals. No study in people is published.

glp1-body-map-v2.alt: Drawing of the front of a human head and trunk, down to the hips. The brain, the stomach and the pancreas behind it are in colour; the body is a faint outline.

glp1-body-map-v2-dark.alt: The same drawing on a dark background: the front of a head and trunk with the brain, the stomach and the pancreas in colour.

glp1-action-art.alt: Four separate organs on a plain background: a brain seen from the side at the top, a blood vessel across the middle, a pancreas at the bottom left and a stomach at the bottom right.

glp1-action-art-dark.alt: The same four organs on a dark background: a brain seen from the side, a blood vessel across the middle, a pancreas and a stomach.

zagreb-medical-school.alt: The main building of the School of Medicine in Zagreb: a glass front that reflects an older building, above a paved square with benches and a small statue.
zagreb-medical-school.caption: The main building of the medical school in Zagreb, Croatia.

fibroblast-actin.alt: Three cells on a black background under a microscope. Fine red threads fill each cell, with a blue centre and small green worm-like shapes.
fibroblast-actin.caption: Mouse cells with their actin threads stained red. Thymosin beta-4 holds single actin units inside cells.

duodenum-villi.alt: A thin slice of gut wall under a microscope, stained purple and pink. Many finger-like folds point outwards from a curved base.
duodenum-villi.caption: The lining of the upper small intestine. Some cells here release the hormone GIP after a meal.

human-pancreatic-islet.alt: A thin slice of pancreas under a microscope. A round cluster of cells stained dark blue, edged with red cells, sits in pale pink tissue.
human-pancreatic-islet.caption: Cells in a human pancreas. Red cells make glucagon. Blue cells make insulin. Retatrutide also acts on the glucagon receptor.

anterior-pituitary-histology.alt: A thin slice of gland tissue under a microscope. Round cells stained pink, purple or pale blue lie close together, each with a dark centre.
anterior-pituitary-histology.caption: The front part of the pituitary gland, a small gland under the brain. Growth hormone is made here.

cdc-hand-washing.alt: Two hands held under a running tap over a steel sink. The person wears a white protective gown; no face is shown.
cdc-hand-washing.caption: Washing hands under running water. Clean hands are the first step before any injection.

ambulance-den-haag.alt: A yellow Dutch ambulance with blue and red stripes and the Dutch emergency number on its side, parked outside an ambulance station.
ambulance-den-haag.caption: A Dutch ambulance in the Haaglanden region. When a life is in danger, call your local emergency number.

stethoscope-grey.alt: A stethoscope with black tubing and a silver chest piece lying on a plain grey surface.
stethoscope-grey.caption: Talk to a doctor before you start.

bacillus-cereus-plates.alt: A round lab dish split into a clear half and a red half, with creamy white bacterial colonies growing across both.
bacillus-cereus-plates.caption: Colonies of bacteria grown on a lab dish.

staph-aureus-usda-sem.alt: Two round bacteria under an electron microscope, surrounded by a web of fine threads, shown in blue-green.
staph-aureus-usda-sem.caption: Staph bacteria seen under a strong microscope. This kind of germ can cause skin infections.

sharps-bin-yellow.alt: A yellow plastic container with a red lid and a small flap opening on top, on a white background.
sharps-bin-yellow.caption: A sharps container: a hard plastic box for used needles, with a lid that closes tightly.

insulin-crystals.alt: Clear crystals with many flat sides, some stacked together, on a pale blue background under a microscope.
insulin-crystals.caption: Insulin crystals, seen up close. The photo comes from NASA.

online-vial-risks-art.alt: A simple line drawing of a small clear glass vial with a grey rubber stopper and a little white powder at the bottom, on a light grey background. It has no label.

online-vial-risks-art-dark.alt: The same line drawing of a small clear glass vial with a grey rubber stopper and a little white powder at the bottom, on a near-black background. It has no label.

contamination-infection-art.alt: A cut through healthy skin seen from the side: the skin on top, a yellow fat layer with a lymph vessel and a blood vessel, and muscle below.

contamination-infection-art-dark.alt: The same cut through healthy skin on a dark background: skin, a fat layer with a lymph vessel and a blood vessel, and muscle below.

incretin-receptors-art.alt: Separate organs on a plain background: a brain at the top, a liver, a short blood vessel and a stomach in the middle, a pancreas and a block of fat below.

incretin-receptors-art-dark.alt: The same separate organs on a dark background: a brain, a liver, a short blood vessel, a stomach, a pancreas and a block of fat.

muscle-tissue-art.alt: A block of muscle on a plain background. The cut end shows bundles of muscle fibres; long fibres run along its length.

muscle-tissue-art-dark.alt: The same block of muscle on a dark background, with bundles of fibres on its cut end and long fibres along its length.

signpost-crossroads.alt: An old wooden signpost on a green hillside, with arms pointing along different paths.

consulting-room-door.alt: A closed wooden door in a clinic corridor with a small sign that reads Consulting Room 5.

amino-acid-crystals.alt: Long, flat crystals in yellow, orange and blue on a pink background, seen through a microscope.
amino-acid-crystals.caption: Crystals of amino acids on a glass slide. The photo was taken through a microscope with polarised light.

mass-spectrometer-fda.alt: A gloved hand puts a small sample into a tray of wells on a large laboratory machine full of tubes and wires.
mass-spectrometer-fda.caption: Samples go into a mass spectrometer at the US regulator. It can show what is in a sample.

blood-sample-analyser.alt: A small tube of blood stands in a round holder inside a grey laboratory machine.
blood-sample-analyser.caption: A blood sample waits in a lab machine. Blood tests show how some organs are doing.

huisartsenpost-oss.alt: The glass entrance of a modern Dutch health building under a large overhanging floor, with a tree and a paved square in front.
huisartsenpost-oss.caption: A GP post for evenings, nights and weekends (huisartsenpost) in the Dutch town of Oss.

vital-signs-monitor.alt: A black monitor screen with coloured wave lines and large numbers for heart rate, oxygen level and blood pressure.
vital-signs-monitor.caption: A hospital monitor shows heart rate, blood oxygen and blood pressure. Here it is connected to a training model, not a patient.

hospital-emergency-entrance.alt: A brick hospital building with a glass canopy over the doors and a large red sign that reads EMERGENCY.
hospital-emergency-entrance.caption: The entrance to a hospital emergency department in Rhode Island, United States.

law-library-shelf.alt: Shelves full of old law books with brown leather spines and small library labels.
law-library-shelf.caption: Old law books in a court library.

ridderzaal-binnenhof.alt: A brick medieval hall with two pointed towers and a round window, behind a wide cobbled square with a gilded fountain.
ridderzaal-binnenhof.caption: The Ridderzaal in The Hague, in the heart of the Dutch parliament buildings.

belgian-federal-parliament.alt: A pale stone building with tall columns, a carved front and two flags, behind a neat garden.
belgian-federal-parliament.caption: Brussels: the house where the Belgian lawmakers meet.

ema-building-amsterdam.alt: A tall office tower with a grid of dark windows under a blue sky, with a metal sculpture by the entrance.
ema-building-amsterdam.caption: The EU's medicines agency has its home in this tower in Amsterdam.

lab-96-well-plate.alt: A pipette with eight thin tips puts pink liquid into a plastic plate with many small wells.
lab-96-well-plate.caption: Lab research: a liquid goes into a test plate with many small wells.

pharmacy-mortar.alt: An old brass mortar with two handles and a heavy brass pestle standing in it.
pharmacy-mortar.caption: An old mortar from a pharmacy. A pharmacy may still make some medicines itself.

reichstag-berlin-west.alt: A large stone building with columns, four corner towers and a glass dome, with German flags, in evening light.
reichstag-berlin-west.caption: The Reichstag in Berlin. The German parliament meets here.

palace-of-westminster-dusk.alt: A long gothic palace with towers and a clock tower, lit up at dusk and reflected in a river.
palace-of-westminster-dusk.caption: The Palace of Westminster in London. The UK Parliament meets here.

fda-white-oak-building.alt: A modern office and laboratory building with a glass front and long rows of windows, under a clear blue sky.
fda-white-oak-building.caption: An FDA lab building in the state of Maryland, in the US.

athletics-track-lanes.alt: The start of a red running track, with white lines and the lane numbers 1, 2 and 3 painted on it.
athletics-track-lanes.caption: Lanes on an athletics track.

flags-european-parliament-strasbourg.alt: A row of national flags on tall poles in front of a round glass building, with the sun behind clouds.
flags-european-parliament-strasbourg.caption: A row of flags in front of the EU parliament in Strasbourg, France.

protein-model-csiro.alt: A computer drawing of part of a protein on a black background: thin blue sticks for the chain and clouds of coloured dots around it.
protein-model-csiro.caption: A computer model of part of a protein. Scientists draw molecules like this to see their shape.

ball-and-stick-model.alt: Close-up of a plastic molecule model: red, black, blue and white balls joined by thin metal rods.
ball-and-stick-model.caption: A ball-and-stick model. Each ball is an atom, and each rod is a chemical bond.

endothelial-cells-fluorescent.alt: Cells under a microscope on a black background, with blue round centres, green threads and small orange specks.
endothelial-cells-fluorescent.caption: Cells from the lining of a cow's blood vessel, stained with dyes. Each cell's centre is blue.

wooden-hourglass.alt: A wooden hourglass standing upright, with sand running from the top glass into the bottom glass.
wooden-hourglass.caption: An hourglass. Half-life is the time it takes for half of a medicine to leave the blood.

gastric-mucosa-he.alt: The lining of the stomach under a microscope, stained pink and purple, with deep folds and tightly packed gland cells.
gastric-mucosa-he.caption: The lining of the stomach under a microscope. Its cells release pepsin, an enzyme that cuts protein.

nlm-main-reading-room.alt: A large library reading room with wooden tables, chairs and low bookshelves, and computer desks further back.
nlm-main-reading-room.caption: The main reading room of the US National Library of Medicine in 2008. The library runs PubMed.

book-and-magnifier.alt: An old open book with one page lifting as it turns, and a magnifying glass lying beside it.
book-and-magnifier.caption: An old book and a magnifying glass. We check each claim against its source.

pharmacy-balance.alt: An old balance with two empty metal pans hanging from a gold-coloured stand on a wooden box with two drawers.

errata-1793.alt: A yellowed page from an old book with a printed list of page and line numbers, each mistake, and its correction.
errata-1793.caption: An errata page in an old book: a printed list of the printer's mistakes and their corrections.

kelsey-kennedy-1962.alt: A black-and-white photo of President John F. Kennedy handing a pen to Frances Kelsey, with men in suits watching.
kelsey-kennedy-1962.caption: In 1962, President Kennedy hands a pen to Frances Kelsey. At the FDA she said no to thalidomide.

tweede-kamer-plenary-hall.alt: An empty debating chamber with rows of wooden desks and blue chairs in a half circle, a speaker's desk and a Dutch flag.
tweede-kamer-plenary-hall.caption: The debating hall of the Dutch lower house in The Hague, seen in 2018.

wooden-gavel.alt: A light wooden gavel with a turned handle, lying on a white surface in front of a white wall.

wooden-ladder.alt: A tall wooden ladder made of poles, seen from below, leaning against a pale wall in front of large green banana leaves.
wooden-ladder.caption: A wooden ladder. Cell and animal studies are the lowest steps of the evidence ladder.

coin-toss.alt: A coin spinning in the air above a hand with the thumb raised, against a green background.
coin-toss.caption: A coin toss. In a small study, chance alone can make a treatment look as if it works.

hooded-lab-rat.alt: A black-and-white hooded laboratory rat with long whiskers, standing in the corner of a white box.
hooded-lab-rat.caption: A hooded lab rat. Few of the things that help in animals become medicines for people.

three-measuring-scales.alt: Three measuring scales side by side on a white surface: the end of a yellow tape measure, a pale blue tape marked in centimetres and a metal ruler, each marked differently.
three-measuring-scales.caption: Three rulers, each with its own scale. We grade evidence on four scales and never add them up.

handshake-drawing.alt: A black line drawing of two hands shaking, on a white background.
handshake-drawing.caption: A handshake. Studies paid for by the maker more often find good results for its product.

human-serum-albumin.alt: Computer model of the blood protein albumin: green spiral ribbons, with small orange chains of fat held inside it.
human-serum-albumin.caption: Albumin, a blood protein. The original CJC-1295 was built to bond to it and last for days.

adipose-tissue-micrograph.alt: Fat tissue under a microscope: large, pale, many-sided fat cells with thin pink walls, packed tightly together.
adipose-tissue-micrograph.caption: Fat cells under a microscope. In trials, tesamorelin shrank deep belly fat, but only while it was used.

human-brain-midsagittal-specimen.alt: Half of a preserved human brain, cut down the middle, in a clear box of fluid. The folds, the brainstem and the cerebellum at the back show.
human-brain-midsagittal-specimen.caption: From a teaching collection. PT-141 acts on receptors in the brain. How it changes desire is not known.

dysplastic-nevus-micrograph.alt: Skin under a microscope, stained pink and purple: a thin top layer with brown pigment along its base, and small clusters of pigment cells just below it.
dysplastic-nevus-micrograph.caption: An abnormal mole under a microscope. Melanotan II darkens moles. Its link to skin cancer is unknown.

mitochondria-lung-tem.alt: Black-and-white electron microscope image of two oval mitochondria with folded inner walls, inside a lung cell.
mitochondria-lung-tem.caption: Two mitochondria, the energy parts of a cell. MOTS-c is made from their own small set of genes.

pineal-gland-he.alt: Pink and purple stained tissue under a microscope: tightly packed cells of the pineal gland with small blood vessels between them.
pineal-gland-he.caption: This gland makes the sleep hormone melatonin. Epitalon was based on an extract of it from cattle.

rat-hippocampus-nih.alt: Microscope image of a rat brain slice in blue, green and gold. Curved gold bands of tightly packed cell nuclei trace the layers of the hippocampus.
rat-hippocampus-nih.caption: The hippocampus of a rat. In rats, Semax raised a growth factor for nerve cells in this area.

macrophage-sem-niaid.alt: Colourised electron microscope image of a round, bumpy immune cell in green, with long thin arms, on a brown background.
macrophage-sem-niaid.caption: An immune cell that eats germs. Selank is built on tuftsin, which stirs up such cells.

thymic-corpuscle.alt: Pink and purple stained tissue under a microscope: a large pink swirl of flattened cells surrounded by many small dark immune cells.
thymic-corpuscle.caption: Tissue from the thymus, seen under a microscope. Thymosin alpha-1 was first found in calf thymus.

skin-epidermis-dermis-he.alt: A slice of human skin under a microscope: a thin purple outer layer above a thicker, pale pink layer of fibres, with small clusters of cells from a harmless mole deeper down.
skin-epidermis-dermis-he.caption: Human skin under the microscope. Cosmetics with GHK-Cu go on the top layer; injections go below the skin.

adipose-tissue-low-power.alt: Fat tissue under a microscope: many large, empty-looking round cells with thin purple walls.
adipose-tissue-low-power.caption: Fat tissue under the microscope. AOD-9604 helped obese rodents lose fat; in people, weight loss was not shown.

cardiac-muscle-cross-section.alt: Heart muscle under a microscope: long pink fibres with dark purple cell nuclei.
cardiac-muscle-cross-section.caption: Heart muscle under the microscope. In rat hearts, hexarelin attached to CD36, a protein on heart cells.

skeletal-muscle-fibres-he.alt: Muscle fibres under a microscope: long pink strands with fine cross-stripes and dark nuclei along their edges.
skeletal-muscle-fibres-he.caption: Muscle under the microscope. A US approval covers muscle strength in one rare disease.

vitamin-b3-crystals-polarised.alt: Vitamin B3 crystals under polarised light, forming blue, green and purple star-shaped patterns.
vitamin-b3-crystals-polarised.caption: Vitamin B3 crystals in polarised light. The body makes NAD+ from NR and NMN, two forms of B3.

parliament-hill-centre-block.alt: A large stone gothic building with a tall clock tower in the middle, under a clear blue sky, with a lawn in front.
parliament-hill-centre-block.caption: The Centre Block on Parliament Hill in Ottawa. Canada's Parliament makes the country's federal laws.

parliament-house-canberra-dusk.alt: A long, low white building with a tall four-legged flagpole on its roof, lit up at dusk and reflected in a pool.
parliament-house-canberra-dusk.caption: Parliament House in Canberra. Australia's Parliament makes the country's federal laws.

beehive-parliament-wellington.alt: A round, many-storeyed building beside an older stone building with columns and palm-like trees, under a cloudy sky.
beehive-parliament-wellington.caption: The Beehive and Parliament House in Wellington, where New Zealand's Parliament meets.

leinster-house-dublin.alt: A wide grey stone building with tall windows and a small front door, seen across an empty courtyard.
leinster-house-dublin.caption: Leinster House in Dublin, where the Irish Parliament meets.

weather-vane-rooster.alt: A red metal rooster on top of a weather vane, with the letters N, S, E and W below it, against a pale blue sky.
weather-vane-rooster.caption: A weather vane shows which way the wind blows. This page shows which way the rules are moving.
